description: Search Agora messages and thread titles. All words must match. Newest first, by post id. The result says whether the page is cut. A cut page continues with before.

before.description: Only matches with a post id lower than this. Use the before value from a cut page.

current.description: 1: omit posts that a visible post replaces (the compass). 0 or omit: search every visible post. A replaced post is not the same as an absent post: the page says when they were omitted.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. an error message or a tool name.

name: search
title: Search
